caption: Parnassus Slopes, Parnassus
composition: Closed, unlit chairlift on the upper Parnassus slopes · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: On the upper slopes of Parnassus, a still chairlift and its pylons cross rock and alpine grass. The chalet is dark. The sky is clear, about 2.4°C, with wind near 0.4 km/h and no precipitation in the model. The ski season is not underway in late September, so there is no night-ski lighting. A light frost is visible on the grass in the frame; that is not presented as a measured snowpack.
